summary.text: Bob Peterson is a Republican state representative and farmer from Fayette County who has represented Ohio House District 91 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the Ohio Senate from 2012 to 2022 and as a Fayette County commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Peterson earned a B.S. in agriculture from Ohio State University in 1983.
He managed Peterson Family Farm and served as president of the Ohio Farm Bureau and the Fayette County Farm Bureau.
Peterson served on the Fayette County Commission from 1996 to 2010, in the Ohio House from 2011 to 2012 and in the Ohio Senate for District 17 from 2012 to 2022.
Ballotpedia says he was appointed to the Senate seat after the March 2012 primary.
He returned to the House in 2023 and defeated Democrat Ellen Clark in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Amy Wright is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
